errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart. The vertical axis lists the categories, and the horizontal axis displays the percentage values. The description has the axes swapped.
The chart label is 'няма нужда от подкрепа' (no need for support). The description omits 'няма' (no), changing the meaning to 'need for support'.
The description states the categories are arranged randomly. However, the top four bars are sorted in descending order of their value, which is a significant structural feature.
This is a repetition of a previous error. The percentage for 'финансова подкрепа' (financial support) is approximately 55%, not 30%.

This is a repetition of an earlier awkward phrasing. It should refer to the 'value of each bar' (стойността на всеки стълб), not 'values of each bar chart' (Стойностите на всяка стълбовидна диаграма).
The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the bars vary in length (дължина), not height (височина).
The description states the bar values range from 10% to 60%. The actual range shown in the chart is from approximately 16% to 55%.
The description fails to describe the horizontal axis, which represents percentages from 0% to 60% with tick marks every 10%.
